title: End-Semester Examination Registration Notification
message: Registrations for S5 B.Tech regular and supplementary end-semester examinations are now open on the Rexa portal. Last date without fine: 20th September 2026.
author: Controller of Examinations

title: KTU Activity Points Verification Deadline
message: All S5 and S7 students must submit their pending activity certificates and proof documents through RSMS Connect on or before 25th September for faculty advisor approval.
author: Dean Academics

title: Campus Placement Drive: Google Cloud & Oracle Financial Services
message: Pre-placement talks and coding assessments for 2026 passing out batch will commence from 15th September. Registered students must carry updated resumes and RSMS Hall Tickets.
author: Placement & Training Cell

title: Abhiyantriki 2026 - Annual National Tech Fest
message: Rajagiri national technical fest Abhiyantriki will be held on October 10-12, 2026. Project expo registrations are now live with prizes worth Rs 3,00,000.
author: Student Council
